# Fikkert & Zn. fixture — seed material

Raw material for the canonical company fixture (see the sustainable-testing design). These files are the former `meta/` workspace — the maintainer's real awow-on-awow context, frozen as of 2026-05-25 and retired from active use.

They are **not** the fixture itself. Building `tests/fixtures/fikkert/` means transforming them:

- keep the structure (the only complete worked example of a populated `context/` tree),
- replace every real fact (Cauchy mission, maintainer handle, GitHub project #3, `awow-test` label) with Fikkert & Zn.'s synthetic ones,
- refresh conventions against the current template — this snapshot predates the department layer and the M365 harness.

`agents-CLAUDE.md` was `meta/.agents/CLAUDE.md`; `backlog.md` and `setup-progress.md` are the dogfood wizard run's state, kept for reference on how a populated workspace was authored (by actually running `/setup-awow`).

Delete this directory once the fixture proper exists.
